web_events.query: Federal Reserve speech this week monetary policy
web_events.answer: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's recent press conference indicated a more hawkish bias towards interest rates, suggesting possible future rate hikes as early as October. Warsh's approach to monetary policy has been characterized by a quieter, more circumspect communication style reminiscent of former chair Alan Greenspan.
